meta.title: AgentBridge — Connector Evidence & Verification Separation Model
meta.subtitle: Strict Separation of Configuration, Reachability, Authentication & Usage Evidence
meta.description: Evidence aggregation model illustrating the strict anti-assumption discipline in AgentBridge. Configuration does not imply reachability; reachability does not imply valid credentials; capabilities do not imply runtime verification; and registration never implies usage.

states.label: Declared Definition & Environment
states.description: Declared metadata, required environment keys, and endpoint definitions.

states.label: CONFIGURED
states.description: All declared configuration keys and environment variables are present and non-empty. Does NOT imply network connectivity.

states.label: CONNECTED & REACHABLE
states.description: Socket, HTTP endpoint, or process spawned successfully. Does NOT imply accepted credentials or authorization.

states.label: AUTHENTICATED
states.description: Explicit upstream handshake or auth token challenge accepted. If untested, remains strictly UNKNOWN (never guessed).

states.label: CAPABILITIES DISCOVERED
states.description: Tools, resources, and schemas inspected without executing mutations or running destructive commands.

states.label: VERIFIED
states.description: All diagnostic gates pass: configuration, reachability, authentication, capability discovery, and health checks.

states.label: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED
states.description: Some checks succeeded but critical items remain UNKNOWN (e.g. offline dry run or untested auth challenge).

states.label: FAILED
states.description: At least one definitive check failed (e.g. missing required token, connection refused, or invalid auth credentials).

states.label: USAGE EVIDENCE (Orthogonal)
states.description: Derived strictly from ActivityStore tool execution history. Distinct states: OBSERVED_IN_USE, NOT_OBSERVED, or UNKNOWN.
